messages:
anya: quick heads-up — we're planning a migration to change the ingest shard key from route_id -> (route_group, window_start). goal is to reduce hot shards for console telemetry and improve dashboard query p99s. proposing dual-write + staged read-adapter. comments?

sam: sounds reasonable. main worry is dashboard queries that currently assume single route_id sharding. we could see p95 regressions if reads hit new partitioning unexpectedly. need a safe read fallback.

michael: rough plan from infra: 1) dual-write at ingest for 2w, 2) shadow read adapter behind a feature flag for 1w, 3) canary traffic 5%->25%->100% with metric gates. backfill via streaming fanout to build new partition indexes rather than a heavyweight full-table rewrite.

kevin: quota calc question — our quota lookup service keys by route_id today. what's the mapping strategy to keep quota lookups correct during dual-write?

anya: good catch. propose a small mapping table route_id -> route_group with TTL in quota service; pre-populate for top 10k routes and warm caches during canary. fallback path will query old key when mapping miss.

anya: ops checklist snippet: 
```
- enable dualwrite ingest flag
- start shadow writer to new partitions
- run background fanout job to seed partitions for active routes
- enable read adapter behind canary flag for subset of dashboards
- monitor gating metrics (error_rate, p50/p95 latency, result parity)
```

ops-bot: deploybot: canary job scheduled: job/ingest-canary-1765201200 (ETA 30m) :bell:

michael: also need console UX changes — add a rollout status label per tenant: "ingest-shard-v2" with states (not-started / dualwrite / shadow-reads / canary / cutover). helps support and SRE triage.

sam: retention/compaction note: compact jobs assume window_start buckets aligned a certain way. new windowing semantics must be compatible with existing compaction queries, otherwise historical aggregates will be off. please add query compatibility tests.

kevin: I'll add a compatibility layer in quota service for 48hr (map-on-read) plus a background reconciliation job that corrects counts if we detect drift.

anya: updated rollout plan: dualwrite (2w) -> shadow reads + metrics parity checks (1w) -> canary 5% -> 25% -> 100% (gates at each step) -> cutover if no regressions. backout: toggle dualwrite=false and revert read adapter. will publish runbook and alerts.

michael: infra approves in principle; let's avoid heavy resharding during peak hours — plan maintenance window (low traffic) for cutover steps.

sam: LGTM. please codify gating thresholds in runbook: error_rate < 0.1%, p50 delta < 5ms, p95 delta < 20ms, result-parity > 99.9% for sampled queries. also add a smoke test that compares sample query sets across old/new paths.

ops-bot: runbook link: https://wiki.internal/ingest-shard-window-rollout (draft)

anya: I'll open the PR for the adapter + runbook now and tag @kevin and @sam for quota & dashboard checks. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
